suggestion.reason: Fixes a visible desktop notification bug in a surface f5 has.

suggestion.reason: Fixes SnapShot capturing the wrong window on macOS.

topics.title: macOS SnapShot skips auxiliary browser helper windows

suggestion.reason: Fixes sidebar grouping of unrelated repos, which can happen in f5's project grouping.

topics.title: A zero Git fetch interval also stops fetch and auto-pull on window focus

suggestion.reason: This fixes terminal clipboard and multiplexer misbehavior.

topics.title: Integrated terminals don't inherit tmux, screen or Zellij variables

suggestion.reason: Fixes a mismatch between what Settings displays and what the composer actually uses.

topics.title: Settings shows the model a hidden default falls back to

suggestion.reason: Fixes checkpoint failures on Windows, which f5 can hit.

topics.title: Checkpoints work in Windows workspaces with paths over 260 characters

suggestion.reason: Fixes panel focus being taken away in a surface f5 has.

topics.title: Returning to a thread no longer jumps to its pull request tab

suggestion.reason: Small layout fix in a composer surface f5 has.

topics.summary: The branch toolbar overflow check subtracts inline padding, so branch labels collapse correctly at narrow widths.
topics.title: Composer context strip subtracts its padding when measuring space

suggestion.reason: This fixes a preview browser bug that blanks tabs and breaks automation.

topics.title: Preview tabs no longer go blank when the tab list reorders

suggestion.reason: PR hub UX fix in a surface f5 has.

topics.summary: Turn completion triggers a background refresh that keeps unchanged diff pages, instead of a hard reset that unmounted the viewer and jumped to the top.
topics.title: PR Code tab keeps its scroll when a turn finishes

suggestion.reason: Mobile app only.

topics.title: Typed answers to pending questions survive leaving and returning to a thread

topics.title: Project script commands stay out of shell history

topics.title: Preview viewports keep their size when the main window is zoomed

topics.title: Port checks work on hosts with IPv6 disabled

suggestion.reason: Saved connections could stay disconnected after the host became compatible again. Needs reimplementing in f5's connection layer, since client-runtime does not exist here.

topics.summary: A protocol mismatch now pauses the environment instead of saving it as switched off. Clearing the block reconnects environments that were enabled. Environments the user disabled stay off.
topics.title: Incompatible hosts no longer switch environments off permanently

suggestion.reason: Network reliability fix that affects outbound fetches such as the provider registry.

topics.summary: The CLI raises Node's autoSelectFamilyAttemptTimeout, so a slow IPv4 connect is not abandoned when IPv6 is advertised but unroutable. Before, the ACP Registry fetch failed.
topics.title: ACP Registry loads on networks with slow IPv4 connects
fix(mobile): open pending tasks from the iPad sidebar (#15083)

suggestion.reason: Applies to saved remote environments and the client-runtime connection registry, which f5 does not have.

topics.summary: Turning a saved environment back on clears the cached unsupported state and retries the handshake.
topics.title: Re-enabling a saved direct connection retries a cached compatibility rejection

suggestion.reason: Fixes usage limits that look complete after a failed probe. f5 has the same usage subsystem; reimplement in f5's provider usage layer.

topics.summary: Sparse usage-limit updates keep the probeFailed marker, including when no snapshot exists yet. Unchanged updates keep the same snapshot object, so token-usage ticks don't republish it. Applies to Claude and Codex.
topics.title: A mid-turn usage update no longer hides a failed limits probe

suggestion.reason: A sidebar UX fix. f5 has subagent threads.

topics.summary: An open subagent is represented by its nearest ancestor that has a sidebar row. That row stays highlighted and anchors search and next/previous navigation.
topics.title: Sidebar keeps the parent thread highlighted while a subagent is open

suggestion.reason: Fixes lost prompt text for Claude skills in the composer.

topics.summary: A skill chip after other text sends the full request, with mentions written as /name, before the final command block. The model no longer loses the rest of the prompt.
topics.title: Claude skill chips placed mid-sentence keep the whole request

suggestion.reason: Subagent completion wakes exist in f5. Reimplement the Stop fix in f5's orchestrator.

topics.summary: Stop disposes both the incoming completion cohort and the cohort of tasks delegated during the wake, so a late child completion no longer wakes the thread again.
topics.title: Stopping a completion-wake run also stops tasks delegated during it

suggestion.reason: A small visual fix in the PR hub.

topics.summary: Comment, review and resolved headers in the PR summary align by text baseline. The fix button's manual offset is removed.
topics.title: Pull request comment headers align on the text baseline

suggestion.reason: Visible fix for Pi provider timeline notices.

topics.summary: Pi notify events become visible system notices instead of folded notify tool calls. Notification and extension-error ids include the provider turn id, so threads no longer overwrite each other's notices.
topics.title: Pi extension notifications render as notices with distinct ids

suggestion.reason: Fixes ACP handshakes in effect-acp, which the fork shares.

topics.summary: Typed RPC request ids no longer start at 2**32. They now start from a constant that fits in Int32, so Kotlin ACP SDK agents such as Junie can initialize.
topics.title: ACP request ids stay within signed 32-bit so Kotlin agents respond

suggestion.reason: Fixes wrong change totals in f5 for branches that track a non-primary remote.

topics.summary: The base resolves the branch's qualified remote-tracking ref before falling back to the primary remote. A lagging fork origin no longer adds commits that are already upstream to Changes or review previews.
topics.title: Changes compare the default branch with its tracking upstream

suggestion.reason: Forge fix for PR linking. Reimplement inside f5's GitLab forge layer, since source-control-* packages don't exist.

topics.summary: Confirms a remote's host through glab auth so self-hosted GitLab without 'gitlab' in its hostname is identified. Also normalizes userless SCP remotes without mistaking Windows drive paths for hosts.
topics.title: Self-hosted GitLab projects resolve bare pull request numbers

suggestion.reason: Observability improvement in the desktop backend manager.

topics.summary: A backend killed by a signal is logged as 'killed by SIGKILL' in the output log and restart event, instead of an exit-status read error.
topics.title: Desktop backend exit logs name the killing signal

suggestion.reason: Thread status fix; reimplement in f5's layers, since orchestration-v2 and client-runtime don't exist here.

topics.summary: Pending request summaries carry a blocking flag. Thread status and agent awareness keep showing Working during live work when the pending question is nonblocking, and switch to Input when the work ends.
topics.title: Nonblocking async questions keep a running thread Working

suggestion.reason: Reverted upstream in #22152.

topics.summary: This added MCP tools for reading thread diffs, answering pending approvals and mark_read. Upstream reverted it for widening the permission boundary.
topics.title: MCP agents inspect thread diffs and answer approvals (reverted)

suggestion.reason: Mostly changes upstream's context-handoff lifecycle row and mobile; f5 lacks that subsystem.

topics.summary: Pending and persisted handoff rows use account badges on both endpoints, so a handoff between accounts on the same model is visible. The web icon takes over the compact size used by sidebar rows.
topics.title: Handoffs between accounts show each side's account badge

suggestion.reason: Fixes extension models missing from the Pi model picker.

topics.summary: The Pi RPC discovery timeout goes from 15 s to 30 s, so extension models still appear when Pi starts slowly.
topics.title: Pi model discovery gets 30 seconds on cold start

suggestion.reason: Composer and desktop UX fix for SnapShot, which f5 has.

topics.summary: A capture pins the open question and goes into its attachment draft. It falls back to the thread draft if the question closed, and respects the attachment limit.
topics.title: SnapShots taken during an open question attach to that question

suggestion.reason: Fixes a settings inconsistency on the Usage page.

topics.summary: Past-24h chart axes, hover labels, range header, breakdown and model dialog respect the 12-hour, 24-hour or system time format.
topics.title: Usage hourly labels follow the Time format setting

suggestion.reason: A sidebar status bug that can happen in f5. Reimplement inside f5's orchestrator.

topics.summary: The first non-maintenance dispatch sets a null visit watermark to 1 ms before dispatch, so the completion counts as unread. Imported history stays read.
topics.title: Never-opened background threads show as unread when they finish

suggestion.reason: Fixes a misleading Codex model option display in f5's provider picker.

topics.summary: The provider reads Codex's global service tier (bounded to 3 s) and applies it as the default for models that advertise it. Before, the picker showed Standard while Codex ran Fast.
topics.title: Codex model options show a service tier inherited from global config

suggestion.reason: Gives f5's Antigravity provider an actionable installation failure message instead of a generic one.

topics.summary: ACP process exits keep their signal and stderr enrichment. Antigravity installation recognizes the IPv6 loopback diagnostic and shows fixed guidance, and Google sign-in URLs are redacted.
topics.title: Antigravity install explains IPv6 loopback startup failures

suggestion.reason: Prevents choosing a raw address that skips the alias's SSH settings.

topics.summary: Discovery hides raw known-host addresses that match a configured alias's HostName, and hostname searches now find aliases.
topics.title: SSH host suggestions no longer duplicate configured aliases

suggestion.reason: A UX improvement that shows existing compaction progress. It adds no automatic compaction, so the declined compaction items do not apply.

topics.summary: The Claude adapter publishes a running compaction item and settles that same item when it ends. The web treats a running compaction as active, so follow-ups queue during automatic compaction, for Codex too.
topics.title: Claude automatic compaction shows as running while it happens

suggestion.reason: Prevents duplicate imported threads. Reimplement in f5's importer and event sink.

topics.summary: Inside the publish transaction, the importer checks whether another thread, including archived or deleted ones, owns the native Codex or Claude session. If so, it no longer creates a duplicate thread. Missing runtime metadata is recovered on retry.
topics.title: Bulk import skips native sessions that another thread already owns

suggestion.reason: Only matters when grouped projects span several environments.

topics.summary: The picker lists each physical checkout, with connected ones first and offline ones shown with their status. Picking one pins the draft to that environment.
topics.title: New-thread picker lists each repository checkout across environments

suggestion.reason: It fixes a visible bug in SnapShot, which f5 has.

topics.summary: The SnapShot coordinator drains pending captures only while the setting is on, so disabled SnapShots no longer replay capture sounds or error toasts on focus. Each capture or failure kind gets one sound and one notification.
topics.title: Disabled SnapShots stop retrying captures and playing sounds

suggestion.reason: Fixes missing Claude skills in the composer.

topics.summary: Discovery reads the installed plugin inventory and merged enablement settings, and lists namespaced plugin skills. Existing scope precedence is kept.
topics.title: Skills from enabled Claude plugins appear in the skill picker

suggestion.reason: Provider UX fix for OpenCode, which f5 supports.

topics.summary: session.retry.scheduled updates one provider retry row, which settles on recovery, failure or interruption. Pending retries are restored after a reconnect.
topics.title: OpenCode 2 turns show provider retries
fix(mobile): avoid nested dropdowns for single tools (#15674)

suggestion.reason: Fixes a UI flicker in the PR detail panel.

topics.summary: The condensed-header compensation saves an absolute scroll target instead of a delta, so a scroll position the browser already clamped is not adjusted twice.
topics.title: PR header no longer flickers when scrolled to the bottom

suggestion.reason: Fixes a Claude provider bug that can happen in f5. Reimplement inside f5's Claude adapter.

topics.summary: When Claude accepts an Auto request as Manual, the adapter restores the mode reported by the first init frame, so follow-up turns stop retrying the rejected Auto mode.
topics.title: Claude follow-ups no longer fail in Auto on models that lack Auto

suggestion.reason: Reliability fix for message delivery. The upstream code is in orchestration-v2, so reimplement it in f5's orchestration layer if f5 has the same gap.

topics.summary: While a run is active but its current attempt has no running provider turn, automatic messages are queued instead of being rejected as steers.
topics.title: Auto-delivered messages queue between provider turns

suggestion.reason: Fixes misleading effort labels on subagent bars in f5's timeline. Reimplement it outside client-runtime.

topics.summary: The subagent bar shows only a stored or reported effort for the same model and instance, instead of falling back to a catalog default such as Medium.
topics.title: Subagent bar stops guessing the subagent's effort

suggestion.reason: Visible readability fix in the timeline minimap.

topics.summary: Assistant replies are parsed with remark into plain text for the minimap tooltip. Parsing is capped at the first 1,500 characters.
topics.title: Minimap hover previews show plain text, not raw Markdown
fix(mobile): picking a model shows its remembered options before saving (#15719)

suggestion.reason: This reliability bug stops provider status and usage from refreshing until the window is reloaded.

topics.summary: Each environment's activity report uses ignoreCause instead of ignore, so an interrupt during session teardown no longer ends the reporting loop. Provider health and usage keep refreshing after sleep/wake.
topics.title: Client activity reporting survives an interrupted report
fix(mobile): expanded tool-call groups keep following new calls (#15747)

suggestion.reason: Fixes desktop network endpoint detection, which f5 shows under Connections.

topics.summary: Desktop endpoint discovery identifies Tailscale IPs from the parsed tailscale status and shares one cached status read. Proton VPN's CGNAT address is no longer labeled Tailscale or put in pairing links.
topics.title: Tailscale endpoints exclude other VPNs' 100.64/10 addresses

topics.reason: f5 has no scheduled tasks subsystem.

suggestion.reason: f5 has no scheduled tasks subsystem.

topics.summary: Interval schedules advance by elapsed duration instead of zoned wall-clock time.
topics.title: Scheduled-task intervals keep elapsed time across DST

suggestion.reason: Fixes a gap in the existing auto-settlement feature. It adds no new automatic behavior.

topics.summary: A thread with no messages or runs uses its creation time as its activity anchor, so automatic settlement applies to it after the inactivity window. Before, it stayed in the active list forever.
topics.title: Empty inactive threads settle automatically

suggestion.reason: A reliability fix for a race in turn starts. It must be reimplemented in f5's layers.

topics.summary: After each await, the turn start service checks that this attempt is still current and still starting. Obsolete attempts stop before opening a session or ensuring, resuming or forking the native thread.
topics.title: Superseded provider startups stop before opening sessions

suggestion.reason: Fixes premature completion and duplicate alerts for Claude background wakes.

topics.summary: When Claude ends an empty turn and opens the next one within milliseconds, the empty turn's result no longer settles the run. The thread stays working and completes once.
topics.title: Claude wake runs no longer end empty while Claude is still answering

suggestion.reason: Timeline UX fix in a surface f5 has.

topics.summary: The assistant selection toolbar hides during scrolling and comes back about 150 ms after scrolling stops if the selected text is still visible. Before, scrolling dismissed it for good.
topics.title: Cite button returns after the timeline stops scrolling

suggestion.reason: Only matters when the local environment is disabled and remote environments are used.

topics.summary: Without a primary environment, global shortcut handlers read the first connected environment that has loaded config.
topics.title: Custom shortcuts work when the Local environment is off

suggestion.reason: Fixes a Windows worktree bug that blocks recreating a checkout.

topics.summary: After git worktree remove succeeds, leftover links are unlinked and the empty directories left behind are removed, so the checkout can be created again. Ordinary files are kept.
topics.title: Removing a worktree on Windows no longer leaves junctions behind

suggestion.reason: Fixes usage limits that stayed empty for Claude in f5's usage surface.

topics.summary: Only a fresh result that includes usage keeps the 5-minute TTL. An unauthenticated status clears the cache, so limits appear right after signing back in.
topics.title: Failed or signed-out Claude usage probes are no longer cached

suggestion.reason: Fixes terminal link detection in a file f5 has.

topics.summary: A route that has a query string and follows an HTTP method or 'proxying' (e.g. GET /api/x?batch=1) is no longer detected as a file link. Real paths and URLs still link.
topics.title: Logged request routes in the terminal are no longer file links

suggestion.reason: Fixes user-configured Codex MCP servers being dropped.

topics.summary: Thread config sets only the dotted mcp_servers.t3-code key instead of replacing the whole mcp_servers table, so MCP servers from launch arguments are kept.
topics.title: Codex MCP servers from launch arguments survive T3's server config

suggestion.reason: f5's PR hub supports GitLab. Rebuild this inside f5's GitLab forge layer.

topics.summary: When the first /diffs page returns not found, the GitLab CLI client falls back to /changes?access_raw_diffs=true and keeps the truncation signals. The Code tab then loads on older GitLab.
topics.title: Merge request diffs load on GitLab before 15.7
fix(mobile): app no longer stays on Loading environments after a locked background launch (#15894)
fix(mobile): account badges no longer clip wide initials like WO (#15908)

suggestion.reason: This fixes the legacy V1 importer in orchestration-v2. f5 does not have that subsystem or that import path.

topics.summary: The V1 to V2 thread importer drops unreadable optional message context but keeps the message. Background hydration marks a failed thread for retry and moves on to later threads.
topics.title: One bad legacy message no longer stops server startup

suggestion.reason: Upstream product analytics.

topics.summary: Adds the anonymous PostHog events feature.used and mcp.tool.invoked, with provider and delegation dimensions.
topics.title: Analytics count product feature and MCP tool usage

suggestion.reason: A command palette UX fix.

topics.summary: Nested palette views and file or content search keep the parent query, and Back or Escape restores it. Closing the palette or opening it fresh resets it.
topics.title: Going back in the command palette keeps the search that led there
fix(mobile): match subscription widgets to app theme (#15941)

suggestion.reason: Repairs upstream-specific release data and the V1-to-V2 import, neither of which f5 has.

topics.summary: Migration 066 repairs settlement timestamps from upstream desktop 0.0.35 to 0.0.38 sweeps, in the V1 and imported V2 projections.
topics.title: Migration repairs settled times stamped by old desktop sweeps

suggestion.reason: Fixes a user-visible bug in f5's keybinding settings for users on non-US keyboard layouts.

topics.summary: Recording a shortcut keeps the character the layout produces, such as # or ' on German, instead of the US physical punctuation key. US shifted glyphs still normalize to shift+key. Alt recording is unchanged.
topics.title: Keybinding editor records the typed character on non-US layouts

topics.reason: Applies only to the Clerk sign-in flow, which is covered by relay-cloud.

suggestion.reason: Applies only to the Clerk sign-in flow, which is covered by relay-cloud.

topics.summary: On unpackaged, non-development Windows runs, the Clerk OAuth callback is registered with the Electron executable and main.cjs.
topics.title: Windows OAuth callbacks register with the app entry point

suggestion.reason: Accessibility fix in the timeline and settings, which f5 has.

topics.summary: Scroll to end, composer paging, minimap navigation, Theme Editor reveal and send anchoring check prefers-reduced-motion and position immediately when it is set.
topics.title: Programmatic scrolls jump instead of glide when Reduce Motion is on
fix(mobile): scroll to end jumps instead of glides when Reduce Motion is on (#16015)

suggestion.reason: A small, low-risk UX polish in the thread view.

topics.summary: When only one subagent is pending, its link reads Show, with the accessible name Show subagent <name>. Multiple tasks keep their named links.
topics.title: Waiting banner stops repeating a single subagent's name

suggestion.reason: Fixes stale network endpoint data in desktop settings.

topics.summary: Atom.keepAlive moves before Atom.swr, so the SWR wrapper revalidates on remount. Connections then shows current endpoints after Tailscale connects or disconnects.
topics.title: Connections refreshes stale desktop endpoints when reopened

suggestion.reason: A measurable performance gain in diff views, which f5 uses.

topics.title: Collapsed diff files wait to highlight until they are opened

suggestion.reason: It fixes a terminal opening in the wrong directory, in the terminal and worktrees surface.

topics.summary: A reopened terminal uses its own saved location, including worktreePath: null. Thread defaults apply only when the terminal has no location. Only the web part applies to f5.
topics.title: A checkout terminal stays off the thread's later worktree

suggestion.reason: The Device panel is an upstream devices and simulators feature.

topics.summary: Pending device actions and their errors are scoped to the thread that started them.
topics.title: Device panel results stay in the thread that started them

suggestion.reason: Mobile app only.

topics.summary: The mobile diagnostics screen reads the build number from expo-application.
topics.title: Mobile crash report shows the store build number

suggestion.reason: A small readability fix for provider instance badges, which f5 has.

topics.summary: Badge initials are black or white, whichever has better WCAG contrast against the accent color. Only the web part applies to f5.
topics.title: Provider badge initials stay readable on light accent colors

suggestion.reason: OpenCode threads currently get images only as attachment paths, so the model can miss them. Reimplement in f5's OpenCode adapter.

topics.summary: Supported local images are sent as native prompt files, keeping the attachment-path text. A steer stopped during file lookup is rejected cleanly.
topics.title: OpenCode turns and steers send pasted images to the model

suggestion.reason: Shows the real reason for Cursor turn failures in the thread and to delegating agents.

topics.summary: Failure messages include the SDK's error message, code and status, such as Model Blocked or resource_exhausted, instead of 'Provider turn failed.' Delegating parents see the same reason.
topics.title: Failed Cursor turns show Cursor's reason

suggestion.reason: Timeline bug fix in files that exist in f5.

topics.title: Timeline minimap highlights only the visible rows

suggestion.reason: Fixes a visible rendering bug in timeline Mermaid diagrams, which f5 has.

topics.title: Math labels in Mermaid diagrams render instead of empty boxes

suggestion.reason: Fixes a timeline copy bug that can happen in f5's chat markdown.

topics.title: Copying selected text keeps the Mermaid diagram source

suggestion.reason: Clearer failure messages for providers f5 has. Reimplement in f5's provider layer, not upstream's provider-core.

topics.summary: Provider errors carry an optional reason. The failure banner shows fixed wording for an unreadable attachment or a still-active previous turn instead of a generic failure. Adapters mark these cases.
topics.title: Turn-start failures say why: unreadable attachment or previous turn still running

suggestion.reason: Fixes repository identity and PR features for partial clones.

topics.summary: git remote -v parsers accept a trailing [blob:none] filter annotation. Partial clones keep their repository identity, remote listings and forge resolution.
topics.title: Partial-clone remote annotations are parsed

suggestion.reason: Relay push service only.

topics.summary: The relay moves environmentId, threadId and deepLink under body, so Expo exposes them as notification data on iOS.
topics.title: iOS push notifications open their thread again

topics.title: OpenCode model catalog settles before it is cached

suggestion.reason: A git diff correctness fix that affects fork-based workflows in f5.

topics.summary: Branches with gh-merge-base set to a remote ref compare against that exact remote ref. Unrelated upstream commits no longer show up as feature changes.
topics.title: Changes honor a configured remote merge base such as upstream/main

suggestion.reason: Fixes storage cleanup coverage. Keep f5's storageCleanup.enabled default.

topics.summary: Cleanup reads active and archived threads in one snapshot, so archived checkouts follow the cleanup rules and count as worktree sharers in removal rechecks.
topics.title: Storage cleanup includes worktrees of archived threads

suggestion.reason: Fixes snoozed threads waking too early in f5. Reimplement it in f5's projection and client state, not in orchestration-v2 or client-runtime.

topics.summary: PR sync, PR-link updates and active reordering keep the thread's activity timestamp. A failure wakes the thread only based on the failed run's completion time, not on later runtime metadata.
topics.title: Snoozed threads no longer wake early after background updates

suggestion.reason: A small settings UX fix.

topics.summary: In Settings → Providers, the model name gets the available width first and the slug truncates. A focusable tooltip shows the full name and slug.
topics.title: Provider model names are no longer cut off by long slugs

suggestion.reason: Fixes a false Unavailable status for the OpenCode provider.

topics.summary: The OpenCode --version probe timeout goes from 4s to 10s, so wrapped installs that start slowly cold are detected.
topics.title: Slow OpenCode wrappers no longer show as unavailable

suggestion.reason: Fixes a startup race that drops provider instance settings.

topics.summary: The registry subscribes to settings changes before the seed read, and queued notifications reread the current settings. A failed read keeps the registry intact and is retried on the next change.
topics.title: Provider settings saved during startup are no longer lost

suggestion.reason: Fixes settings that carried over to the wrong model.

topics.summary: Project and checkout model selections now replace the saved options instead of merging with them, for the default, text-generation, writer and review-guide models.
topics.title: Changing a project's model drops the old model's options

suggestion.reason: Fixes dropped fast and priority options for delegated children.

topics.title: Subagents keep fast mode when their reasoning effort is overridden

suggestion.reason: Fixes a wrong completion state in the Claude provider.

topics.title: Claude /goal no longer reads as complete while a background subagent runs

suggestion.reason: Fixes an unwanted background watch on forked threads in f5's PR hub and fork flow.

topics.title: Forked threads no longer inherit pull request watches

suggestion.reason: An observability improvement in serverLogger, which exists in f5.

topics.title: Server logs print the full cause instead of [Object]

topics.title: Session import skips Codex subagent rollouts

suggestion.reason: Desktop deep-link fix for Linux AppImage users, if f5 registers a URL handler.

topics.title: Linux URL handler quotes the Exec path only when it must

suggestion.reason: Users with bare-repo layouts can import their projects during onboarding.

topics.title: Add to agent works on pull requests the user cannot comment on

suggestion.reason: Reliability fix that prevents thread data from being overwritten. Reimplement it in f5's orchestrator.

suggestion.reason: Adds visible startup feedback on desktop. The product name in the label needs to change for f5.

topics.title: Desktop shows a Starting splash while the local backend starts

suggestion.reason: Stops two servers from sharing one data directory, which can corrupt data. This applies if f5 ships the background service.

topics.summary: At startup, the server checks the installed launchd or systemd service for the same home. If that service is older than 0.1.0, or has a deferred update, startup exits 78 with recovery guidance.
topics.title: Server refuses a T3 home used by an older background service

suggestion.reason: One-line header fix. It applies if f5 has scratch projects.

topics.summary: ChatHeader shows 'No project' for scratch projects instead of the renamed scratch project title.

suggestion.reason: Fixes a navigation bug in thread routing that can happen in f5.

topics.title: Opening a just-created thread no longer bounces to the start page

suggestion.reason: A reliability fix for the Codex provider.

topics.summary: The Codex JSONL reader counts UTF-8 bytes across fragments and ends the transport above 128 MiB, instead of running the server out of heap.
topics.title: Codex session ends when an incoming message exceeds 128 MiB

suggestion.reason: Agents get accurate preview tool results instead of a silent success on the wrong tab.

suggestion.reason: Lowers the resource monitor's memory use on macOS.

topics.summary: macOS uses Linux's two-stage collection. Discovery stays lean, and command lines and memory are loaded only for tracked processes.
topics.title: macOS resource monitor stops retaining unrelated process details

suggestion.reason: Reduces token waste in f5's orchestrator MCP delegation responses.

topics.summary: When latestTerminalSummary and the context-transfer ID match the summary fields exactly, they are set to null. This saves agent context on every task-status check.
topics.title: Delegated task status stops repeating the same result twice

suggestion.reason: Clearer timeline labels.

topics.summary: Fixes awkward work-log labels for unwatch, review-guide and delegated-task cancel tool calls.
topics.title: Unwatch, review guide and task cancel labels read as sentences

suggestion.reason: Small visual fix in a settings surface f5 has.

topics.title: Archive panel Unarchive button gets proper icon spacing

suggestion.reason: Clearer provider errors for Cursor. Reimplement in f5's provider layer.

topics.summary: Cursor's plan_required error now appears in provider status and sign-in, explaining that the account needs a paid plan.
topics.title: Cursor status explains when a free-plan account is rejected

suggestion.reason: Prevents surprising data loss in checkpoint rollback.

topics.summary: The confirmation says that reverting files also discards manual edits, and the button uses the destructive-outline style.
topics.title: Edit from here warns that Revert files too undoes your own edits

suggestion.reason: UX fix in chat markdown rendering. f5 has ChatMarkdown.tsx.

topics.title: Table expand button only shows when a cell is cut off

suggestion.reason: Improves observability for the Claude provider. f5 has EventNdjsonLogger.

suggestion.reason: Removes a sixfold duplicate directory scan, if f5 has the same PR cache layer.

topics.title: PR read cache cleanup runs once per shared layer

suggestion.reason: Provider bug fix for Antigravity, which f5 supports. Reimplement in f5's ACP adapter.

topics.title: Antigravity html_render pages show in the thread

suggestion.reason: Prompt fix for delegation and PR-watch flows, reimplemented in f5's runtime instructions.

topics.title: Delegated children report PRs to their parent instead of watching them

suggestion.reason: Measurable performance gain: one fewer git process per status read.

topics.summary: Cached remote-status reads use only the upstream ref and no longer run git remote. Fetch and push resolution are unchanged.
topics.title: Git status reads skip enumerating remotes

suggestion.reason: Fixes a bug in the Cursor provider's skill discovery. Reimplement it in the fork's provider layer.

topics.title: Cursor skill discovery skips node_modules

suggestion.reason: A UX fix in usage, a surface f5 has. It applies if f5 has pooled reset-credit redemption.

topics.title: Usage bar shows reset-credit progress after the popover closes

suggestion.reason: A UX fix in the composer banner stack.

topics.summary: Truncated notice titles use the existing overflow details popover, so a long background command can be read in full.

suggestion.reason: A forge capability f5 can reimplement in its own git layer.

suggestion.reason: Improves error messages for the preview browser.

topics.title: Vite+ provider installs get update prompts on Windows and XDG layouts

suggestion.reason: Only applies to projects that span several environments.

topics.title: Desktop-drawn preview snapshots match the page's scale and viewport
